Bug_Title: "@SpringBootApplication" and "@ComponentScan" should not be used in the default package
Bug_Explanation: The @SpringBootApplication and @ComponentScan annotations should not be used in the default package. This can lead to slow start-up times and BeanDefinitionStoreExceptions.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case attempts to create an instance of the application context. However, since the application is in the default package, it will fail to start due to the @SpringBootApplication and @ComponentScan annotations being used in the default package. This should trigger the bug.
Model_Explanation: The provided Java code does not contain the described bug. The @SpringBootApplication and @ComponentScan annotations are used correctly in the RootBootApp class, which is not in the default package. The code does not contain any @ComponentScan annotation configured with the default package, nor does it contain any @SpringBootApplication or @ServletComponentScan annotations used on a class belonging to the default package.
